label: Applying to Slovenia through eVŠ for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Joint call for enrolment (razpis za vpis) published
milestones.note: Every date in the Slovenian cycle is set by this call. Until the 2027/28 call is out, nothing here has a date.

milestones.label: First application period (prvi prijavni rok) closes
milestones.note: The period that matters. Later periods only fill places left over. As an EU citizen you apply on the Slovenian citizens' timetable, not the foreigners' one.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Your results go into eVŠ after this. How late they may arrive for the first-round decision is set by the call.

supplementarySteps: Log in to eVŠ with SI-PASS. Set this up before the application period opens.
Get it in writing from the faculty whether your IB Diploma needs a recognition procedure. Two official pages disagree, and if it is needed it can take up to two months.

notes: The joint call covers the four public universities and the concession-holding independent institutions. Other private institutions publish their own calls, but applications still go in through eVŠ, so one route covers every institution listed.
No application-system record for eVŠ exists yet; creating one was outside this pass's file ownership. The portal is recorded as portalUrl instead.
The 2026 dates (first-round result on 24 July, and so on) are on the country profile. They are not carried here even as provisional, because the call can move them.
